monochromatic.description: Shades, tints, and muted tones of one hue.

analogous.description: The two hues beside your base on the artist’s color wheel.

complementary.description: Your base and the hue directly opposite it.

split.description: The two hues on either side of your base’s opposite.

triadic.description: Three hues equally spaced around the wheel.

tetradic.description: Two complementary pairs, including your base.
